sentences.en: In the city they knew that Juha is strange.
Children used to make fun of him.
One was big and one was small.
They said: choose one of them.
Juha always took the big one.
The big one was worth less.
The children laughed every time anew.
He said: the small one is worth more.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אתה מפסיד כל יום.
sentences.en: He said: you lose every day.

sentences.ar: ג'וחא אמר: אני יודע את זה.
הוא אמר: אני יודע כבר שנים.
sentences.en: He said: I have known for years.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אבל אם אקח את הקטן.
sentences.en: He said: but if I take the small one.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: הם יפסיקו לשחק איתי.
sentences.en: He said: they will stop playing with me.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: ואז לא אקבל כלום.
sentences.en: He said: and then I shall receive nothing.
